entities.summary: The Masjid Al-Muttaqin, or alternatively known as Al-Muttaqin Mosque, is located in Ang Mo Kio in the Central Region, Singapore. It was officially opened on 21 September 1980 by Haji Rahmat bin Kenap, former People's Action Party Member of Parliament for Geylang Serai.
